review_description: I chose RenewCo Solar as their sales person was the most knowledgeable and willing to put the time and effort to calculate and explain to me exactly what I need in my circumstances. My only little complain would be that they’re waiting list for installation was more then two months long but eventually I am happy I waited as they provide great service. Highly recommended!
Quoting was very comprehensive, and advice was paramount in our decision. Install was very good. Customer service was excellent with help for my questions.

Sales and quoting:Ultimately RenewCo had the cheapest price (for the grade of system) but after comparing other quoted systems decided that the Sigenergy and REC panels was the best system within my budget. RenewCo also offered options for next tier down panels.RenewCo had quoted when both state and federal battery rebates were in place, but then the state (NSW) removed their rebate, Renewco adjusted their offer to lessen (share) the impact of the reduced rebates by upgrading the battery storage.Installation:Worked with me around other factors.RenewCo removed the old PV system, then my solar hot system failed and I replace with a heat pump, Renewco also removed the old hot water panels. And then worked around my roofer doing a roof clean and restoration.Installation crew showed up on time, polite and efficient, system was online by mid afternoon (1 day install).Customer service:Everyone I dealt with was friendly and professional, answered all my questions.

RenewCo Solar was very helpful in tailoring a solar and battery solution which met my energy savings goals. We worked together to develop something that I was very happy with.They kept me thoroughly informed throughout the whole process, and the installation was completed within the day with no issues.Customer service was also fantastic, offering helpful answers to all my questions.Would highly recommend them to anyone wanting a tailored solar and/or battery solution, and a great quality installation!
Couldn’t fault the process from start to finish. Great company to work with
RenewCoSolar were honest and upfront about the batteries and even pointed me in the direction of additional rebates

RenewCo Solar organised a site visit and explained the best battery for my existing solar system.Quote provided with installation date. Everything completed on time as discussed. Installation was efficient and neat.Would highly recommend.

* Good detail on quote* Pricing was within expected range for a good installer* Whatsapp group for questions and answers before, during and after installation* Big group of trades showed up on install day on time and kept going until all was done. Site wa cleaned and no parts were left behind. It was a long day (nearly 12 hours beginning to end).* System was explained after install and final compliance signatures were only done at the very end.* Electrical board changes were walked through including no master cut offs and individual isolation switches. All installation looked professional.

We cannot recommend RenewCo solar enough. The whole process from start to finish was a breeze and managed with professionalism. The quoting process was very easy and the price offered was competitive. They kept us up to date every step of the way. The  was  neat and tidy. Nathan and Korey where incredibly friendly and easy to deal with.They explained everything before and after the install.We highly recommend RenewCo solar

We chose Renew based on price and the professional approach from their sales staff.The install was well managed and exceeded our expectations - very happy with the results.I would recommend this company to others.

The quoting process was easy. I had a rep attend my property to see the site and explain to me how RenewCo Solar system work and the various options. I was impressed with his knowledge. I obtained other quotes but went with RenewCo mainly because they instilled more confidence in me.The installation was excellent. The installers were polite, pleasant and on time. They left the site tidy and explained everything to me.I am impressed with the app that allows me to monitor my system, and with the after installation service (that I haven't yet needed to use).
Fantastic quoting process, excellent customer service, prompt and efficient installation, polite and tidy.

RenewCo Solar were the only people who actually came to site for the quote and helped me understand what was and wasn't possible. They were super proactive in their communication, especially when the rebate amounts changed due to the NSW government rebate changing, and nothing was too much trouble. The team who installed the battery were fast and respectful and a pleasure to have at our home. So far so good!
RenewCo Solar completed a new battery installation with efficiency and good communication.Would recommend them highly to anyone seeking to install a Sigenenergy battery.

RenewCo Solar provided a clear booking process, arrived on time, and did an excellent install and clean up, answering all my questions on the way.  Great communications throughout the process, especially navigating the abrupt cancellation of the NSW rebate program.

Pre-Sale with Rhys was great, factual and knowledgeable. Of four quotes, only two visited our site, Rhys being one.They overcame the hiccup of NSW pulling their rebate with an innovative offer.Lead time was ~ 6 weeks in a peak period (June - July). Installation was scheduled early and didn't change.The installation crew of 3 arrived on time on the scheduled date.They were done and cleaned up in 3 hours.The installation is professional and neat.Everything works as it should.

We're very happy with the whole process provided by RenewCo, from first on-site contact with the battery consultant, to the support staff, and the expert installers on the day. The battery is performing very well and we can only recommend this system to others. Great team and a high quality product. Would use the team here again.

We wanted the best possible system installed with the maximum residential capture and storage.  Of the 4 companies we reviewed, we went with Renewco.  From the beginning they were the most professional. They listened to our requirements, designed the system to our specifications and installed the system and batteries on time and without any issues.Not the cheapest, nor the most expensive.  But, for our needs, definitely the best value and the most professional.  Great service and attention to detail.We’re very happy with our system and happy to recommend the team at Renewco.

It was a pleasure to work with the Renew Solar teamFrom initial engagement through to installation I was kept informed.The Installation team was on time advised me of any changes they needed to make to be complaintAll rubbish was removedI  would highly recommended them and will certainly use them for any future solar and battery needsPricing was very competitive!!

Initial interactions via email and phone were easy and effective. Once signed up, communication with the team via a WhatsApp chat was easy and enabled fast responses.Their price was competitive and clear.They were punctual and clean in the installation process.All round, a great experience.

The sales person came out to inspect our property, he looked at what we had already set up on the roof, checked the power bills and usage.Kurt made some recommendations and said that he would email me the quote once he puts a design together. the NSW government pulled out of the rebates and the company still helped me out with honoring the system quoted.

Was a pleasure dealing with Rhys with quoting and sales process.On the day, the install team arrived on time and we first discussed the full details of our install including materials used and how all the cabling would be run.Whole install took a good 8 hours in total and nearly an hour of cleaning up and going through things.Would recommend RenewCo Solar for competitively priced solar/battery supply & installs, coupled with decent customer support.

RenewCo was extremely professional from beginning to end including the aftercare.  they did not try any pressure sales but provided factual guidance and adapted to our needs.  They organised everything so I didn't need to worry about any parts of the installation or useage.
Great initial contact, install process was easy and install team were very accommodating. Was a very close decision based on price and product offerings between Renew and Smart Energy.

RenewCo Solar delivered what they promised in every way. Proposed installation was explained clearly with prompt follow up of quote.Installation went smoothly with the friendly and professional team completing the job in good time with all waste removed.Especially value the excellent post installation service that is ongoing at no extra cost. A deal breaker for me.I couldn’t fault RenewCo Solar in any way and would highly recommend their services for all things to do with solar and heat pumps.

Sales and quoting process was very easy. They were able to answer all my questions. The installation was excellent. They arrived on time, consulted me along the way, and left my home neat and tidy. The installation looks great. Customer service is awesome already processing connection of a smart meter. I’m looking forward to using my system at maximum capacity.

RenewCo was great to deal with from start to finish. From the initial inspection and quoting, through answering all my questions and helping me make informed choices, to delivery and follow-up - they were professional and supportive throughout.My system has now been running for 9–10 months, and I’m still a happy customer.
All was done efficiently and installed as specified. Group communicated from day one the process and when installation would occur

Sales process was efficient. They came out, looked at what we had already (existing solar), took our requirements and came up with a suggestion of what will meet our needs (A SigEnergy setup).They set up a WhatsApp group where you can ask questions during and after the install which was really good, much more efficient than emailing back and forth.They did make a mistake on the install itself which caused a minor issue, but immediately responded when I queried about it and set up a follow-up to fix it. The way they went about this impressed me a lot.
The team was very professional and polite. The great communication and follow up. We highly recommend Better Call Solar.

This was my second installation of rooftop solar panels and this time included a battery and EV car charger unit.   I spoke to a number of suppliers and selected RenewCo Solar.   They came on time as promised, and were extremely professional and price competitive.   Most of all they were happy to take time and talk with me about options and answer my questions in as much detail as required.  Other installers seem to want to come and go quickly, whereas RenewCo took time to understand our needs, consider options, discuss these with me, and provide a quote with the suggested recommendations.  I went with a Tesla Powerwall 3 battery solution.   The installation team were professional and I was extremely happy with the experience, and in addition with the ongoing product and delivery/intallation of what was promised.  Well done and my thanks to all at the RenewCo team.
CRISP, TO THE POINT.  POLITE, TIDY AND PUNCTUAL.   GREAT SERVICE.

I’m glad I found RenewCo Solar. The sales rep came out for a site inspection, was knowledgeable, and took the time to explain everything clearly. He crafted a proposal that incorporated my suggestions, and we went with a 10.3kW system (Aiko-470 panels and a SolarEdge inverter) at a competitive price. There was a 2.5-month wait between the deposit and installation, which was communicated upfront. The installation team arrived on time, were organised and tidy, and completed the job within the day. They even removed all rubbish, including six broken tiles and our old solar pool heater pipes free of charge. Post-installation support was provided via WhatsApp. The team was responsive, polite, and accommodating. While the system was up and running, there were two (possibly related) monitoring issues, which I raised. These were followed up promptly. I highly recommend RenewCo Solar, great value without compromising on installation quality or after-sales support.

The entire process, adding a few more solar panels to my existing solar system has well executed!From the initial assessment to the final installation - it was a breeze. The communication was great, the installers were polite, tidy and experienced.Whilst 5 other solar installers did the initial assessment and told me that the roof of my tiled house is too steep and installing solar panels can’t be done, Mark’s RenewCo Solar team got the job done! An amazing punch of people!Thank you for your high quality workmanship!

We had an existing solar power system that had a 3 phase solaredge inverter with LG panels. This system had worked flawlessly for over 6 years. I wanted to add a battery to the system so based on my 6 years experience with solaredge I was inclined to stay with their equipment. I obtained pricing from several installers and mainly because my third quote was taking a long time to respond I sent an enquiry to Renewco. Not being based in our area I didn't think that they would be so interested in travelling to us, however, they responded very quickly to my enquiry and arranged a site visit to inspect our existing installation. Matt was very thorough with the inspection and had a quote back to us very promptly. I was offered a couple of system options for consideration, including the solaredge battery with an inverter upgrade which I asked to be included. Their pricing was also very competitive with the other quotes obtained.After answering all my questions on the quotes very promptly I elected to proceed with Renewco.Renewco's process includes setting up a Whatsapp group for communication on the project. This has made communication pre and post installation very effective. All information is retained in the one place for easy reference.Renewco have their own teams doing the installation and the 2 gents (Nathan and Corey) that arrived to do our battery installation were punctual and very accommodating with location of the battery, taking shoes off in the house, cleaning up after themselves etc. Their attention to detail was first class lifting the standard of the original solar installation to theirs with improved conduit routing, mounting of inverter, replacing previous circuit breakers that were added for the original solar installation with breakers that were the same brand as those installed in our switchboard and replacing the main circuit breaker on our main switchboard with one the same brand as all the others.I waited 3 months to do this review as I like to see the system working and if there are any teething problems, how they are resolved.I can say that there was a problem with battery charge / discharge found in the weeks after installation. Through the Whatsapp group we were able to exchange information on what I was seeing and Renewco took this up with Solaredge to resolve. It then took a couple of software changes to get the system right.The true character of a company is shown in the way they approach problems after installation and the invoices are paid. For that I can only applaud Renewco's (and Solaredge's) attitude to make sure the customer is 100% satisfied.The system is now working well and I am confident based on what I have experienced to date that if there are any further issues down the track that they will be attended to.If I have need for further system upgrades, Renewco will be the first company that I contact.

The quoting process was quick. The rep came and visited the property and followed with a quote. We had a quote for the panels and battery. We could not justify the battery so we went ahead with the panels only. There was a 2 month wait for the installation. But the team arrived at the agreed time and completed the job professionally.I was kept informed all the way through the process. They cleaned up afterwards.The system seem to be working fine.

Back in Feb 2024 I had RenewCo install an 8.8kw solar system using 21 REC panels and a hybrid SolarEdge Inverter. I was very happy with their price, level of service, professional approach and their availability if I had any questions. I posted a review back then. At this time I was starting my clean energy journey and knew that an EV car was sometime soon and I had an idea of a battery a little later in the picture. I had RenewCo come back during April 2024 to add 5 more REC panels to take the system to bring it 10.9kw and as well install a Tesla EV charger. Once again the price was competitive by comparison for both items and their service was excellent. I was now covering the house power needs and able to charge the car during the day. I knew I needed to close the gap at night when we had go to the grid for power as our retailer had started to impose demand charges following our switchboard upgrade to a smart meter. Everyone beware, demand charges can be nasty! It was later in November 2024 that I had RenewCo back to install a Tesla Powerwall 2. I had planned it for June but RenewCo let me delay the install until November 2024 when the government rebate kicked in. Thanks RenewCo. Once again the install went perfectly and was done in the day. The system worked perfectly as I expected. It is so important to have a good installer and one you can trust. Now I don’t have any power bills apart from the connection fee sometimes and on the last bill they actually owed me money. I charge the EV on solar during the day as well as the 13kw Tesla battery which is more than enough for us overnight. RewnewCo has help me achieve the great outcomes I was hoping for. Thanks to all the team at RenewCo. I would recommend RenewCo to anyone considering a solar system installation.

I cannot recommend RenewCo solar enough. The whole process from start to finish was a breeze and managed with professionalism. The quoting process was very easy and the price offered was competitive. They kept me up to date every step of the way. The install was incredibly neat and they went above and beyond to keep all the cables tidy and to run cabling in the wall cavities instead of using conduit, which I found impressive. Everyone on the team was incredibly friendly and easy to deal with. I highly recommend RenewCo solar.

Sales was good. I got three quotes and they showed price leadership as the three systems were very similar, so comparable.  Design phase was good we changed the design a couple of times, they were very accommodating.  Installation was the draw card.  The team were very professional, courteous and tidy.  I put on REC panels at the suggestion of Sev the sales guy and I couldn't be happier. They look very good aesthetically and more importantly are performing very well. !!  I would happily recommend RenewCo to anyone..
Sales/quote was personal.Installation of solar panels was tidy, cracked roof tiles were repaired.Customer service is very good.

Contact was made after I got sent 3 names from SolarQuotes.Organised a time to visit. Had a very detailed / informative discussion about all things solar.Kept in regular contact via a WhatsApp with regard with what needed to be done from our end.A date and time was set. The four guys worked about 8hrs taking off our old solar panels, taking on way too many wasps hiding up on roof under old solar panels and installed our new ones. (On a very warm day to boot!Instructions were given before they left with regard to inverter.Contact was made again to organise a time post installation chat about our usage trends.This was done and now awaiting some advice on best energy company to go with.All in all a very seamless journey to lowering our power bill in 2025 and beyond!
I got RenewCo to install a Powerwall 2 as well as a induction cooktop and a heat pump hot water system, the process couldn't have been easier.  Pleasure to deal with.

I found the quote process easy and prompt. The representative came a time that suited me, and was thorough in his explanation, citing the pros and cons of the choices.We arranged a date for the installation itself-panels, inverter system, and battery-and it was all completed that day, having arrived on time.The installers were polite, and tidied up well when they were finished, and organised connection to the grid afterwards. The man in charge was easy to talk to and answered any questions patiently.I would definitely recommend Renew Co Solar to anyone looking for a solar solution.

Our installation was complex. Being a emergency centre it was imperative that the installation of our new Solar and Battery was well planned and executed to prevent any unforeseen outages or other issues. The team were excellent, and we are very satisfied with the result.

RenewCo Solar were efficient with their quoting, which included an onsite inspection and discussion, so I understood exactly what was proposed. The installation had some unique roofing to deal with, and RenewCo Solar liaised very well with my roofer/waterproofer. Their quote was competitive to others for similar quality panels and inverter.The install team were punctual, polite and tidy. On completion, they organised the grid connection and tested the system.All RenewCo Solar's staff were in-house, in other words their workers are NOT subcontracted, which I thought was a significant advantage over other companies that did subcontract their installation staff.RenewCo Solar's backup support has been reliable and helpful.

I worked for the first time with RenewCo Solar when they uninstalled all my existing solar panels so that the roof restoration could be done. After the roof work was completed RenewCo then re-installed and recommissioned all panels back.On-site team was punctual, very professional and had great manners.When the team discovered one stripped connector cable, they didn't only tell me about the issue, but at the same time the suggested the different repair options with their recommendation, to which I agreed to.I was impressed with the whole process and with everybody involved from initial discussions, the actual on-site work and project closure and follow-up.So, when we decided to get the new battery system installed to our existing solar system, I contacted RenewCo for system proposal and then decided to give the whole work to RenewCo. And I couldn't be happier with that decision. Again, everything went really smoothly.RenewCo aftersales support has been really good as well. I have had some questions after the installation and the RenewCo team have always covered them very well.I can highly recommend RenewCo for all solar and battery works.Big thanks to the whole RenewCo team!

RenewCo quoted me 14 additional Rec solar panels and a Tesla PowerWall 3 inverter to add to my existing 40 Trina Honey roof top solar panels. Their quote was very thorough and professionally presented. Their pricing was competitive with other quotes I had. On the day of installation they brought a large team and the entire installation was completed on the one day. The quality of the installation workmanship was first class. The installation team arrived on time, completed the work, cleaned up after themselves and ensured the Tesla app was running on my 'phone before they left. I had quite a few cracked roof tiles which they replaced for me and took away the old, broken  tiles. This is great customer service as it was not covered in their installation proposal. The system has been running perfectly since it was installed and the battery backup functioned seamlessly during three power outages. I would be happy to recommend RenewCo, their staff behaved professionally & ethically at all times, this includes both the sales staff, the office staff and the installation team. I was particularly impressed with the installation staff who went above and beyond what was expected of them. I am a happy customer!

The quote was simple - they came around and provided a few options. We then accepted one of the options and they set me up on a WhatsApp group with all of the relevant team (admin, installer, mgt etc) - that made the process smooth and predictable, and gave me a channel to reach out on and get quick answers to my questions. The install went smoothly - although one connector wasn't fastened - and I saw this in my low solar generation and reported it to them - and they quickly sent a team out to diagnose and resolve the problem. All up it went really well and I am saving a lot of money from my new solar panels and heat p[ump hot water system.
Great process all the way through, from quoting through install and support afterwards

Carson came out to our property that is surrounded by trees, which instantly set him apart from the competition, and explained how Renewco could help.  He provided help at every turn, and we settled on the third solution, which gave us the right balance of cost and performance, never once did he apply any pressure.

I used SolarQuotes to get a couple of potential installers, but quickly settled on RenewCo Solar.  The team listened to my (sometimes quirky!) needs, and we came up with a solution (over a number of iterations) which did what we wanted.  When I wanted a battery, I went back to RenewCo Solar, and had the same excellent experience.Installation was as scheduled, quick, effective and tidy - we knew where we were up to, and what would happen next etc.Commissioning seamless and gave me all the help I needed.After the battery went in, I needed some assistance with our (relatively new at the time) combination of SolarEdge inverter and SignenStor battery system, working with Amber for wholesale tariffs - the team at RenewCo Solar went out of their way to help, and sorted out the various issues (many of which were intercompany interactions, rather than anything that RenewCo Solar themselves were actually responsible for!).All in all, an excellent experience!
Everything went exactly as planned, info was all correct and guidance about the best system was spot on.   It was a good deal and we're 90% self-sufficient.

I got rejected by other companies because of the shape of my roof.These guys studied the issues, came up with a solution and I’ve gone from paying $150ish a month to making money.Couldn’t speak more highly of them.

From first phone call to  installation. Very happy !No hassle , easy to understand all the jargon, friendly, no question too much . Kept me informed all the way . Pleasure to deal with all the staff .Wouldn’t hesitate to recommend

Disappointing experience, would recommend going with a different provider.From leaving electrical cabling dangling over my neighbours driveway, to installing panels that stick out and are visible from the ground floor, to management losing their temper and threatening not to return to correct their mistakes, to repeatedly delaying completing the job (that still isn’t finished as of feb 25)Renewco Solar has been one of the most frustrating companies I’ve had to work with. I’d recommend avoiding them and consider using someone else.

RenewCo Solar have provided an upgrade of our existing 48-panel solar system, which used a Fronius 18kW 3-phase inverter, to a complete Solar Battery system.During the quotation visit it was very easy to discuss our needs with the engineer, and he understood all the needs of our rather complex multiple building installation.The new system uses a stack of three 8kWh SigEnergy batteries with a 20kW hybrid inverter, giving a total storage capacity of 24kWh.The system was made even more complex, since the panels are on the roof of our church hall, the batteries and inverter are located on a mezzanine floor just below this, while the gateway and connection to the grid are located on the wall of an adjacent building where a child-care centre is operated.  The batteries, of course, could not be co-located in this position because of safety issues with children.  This necessitated a 75m cable run between the batteries/inverter and the gateway to provide full backup for the site.  RenewCo Solar was able to offset the cost of this by allowing a trade-in of our original inverter.RenewCo Solar is a family run company, and all of their personnel were very easy to work with and have produced an eminently workable system.  I highly recommend them to any potential customer.

Rhys visited my home and it was clear he knew solar very well. I had 4 other installers contact me. One did not even bother to visit the site and the other 3 were either not able to answer some questions or were wrong on some points.We decided on 11KW of 440W Longi panels with 8 TIGO optimisers for a shaded area, a goodwe inverter and a catch power diverter for our hot water with included Solar Analytics monitoring software.The install was on time and completed professionally. Initially we went for two of the 3 inverter strings to be used but later, prior to the install, we changed that to use all 3. A minor clerical slip up did not change the setup we now decided on and when I discovered only 2 strings were used Rhys arranged for that to be sorted at no cost to me. I have had a few questions about the performance and Cameron has been very helpful in educating me.The catch device has reduced our electricity consumption for the hot water from a third of our bill to less than $20 since the install in July.
Great customer service, easy to deal with, on time and simple

How was the sales/quoting process? Excellent - gave us confidence we picked the best company.How did the installation go? Polite? Tidy? Punctual? All of these, cleaned up, good site practises.How was the customer service? e.g. did they help organise the grid connection after the install, or show you how to use the charger? Yes, grid connected, working, more aftersales still to come. lots of follow-up to ensure we were happy with the install.

RenewCo Solar provided us with various design options in a timely manner. What I really liked wasthat there was no pressure applied to complete the deal as quickly as possible and we had plenty oftime to evaluate the options proposed.We decided to move forward with a solution consisting of REC panels and a 8.0 kW SigenergySigenStor solution. So far, the system has performed well above expectations and includes anumber of innovative features. It has performed so far performed extremely well. Also, thesystem’s safety features, including overcharge protection and battery temperature monitoring, giveus extra peace of mind. We love that we can easily, and cost effectively, expand the store capacityby adding more to the stack in the future. To top it, the look of the inverter and battery module isvery modern and easy on the eye.The removal of the old system and installation of the SigenStor system was completed within 7hours. The team arrived punctually as agreed and was well organised. Overall, the experience wasexcellent and communication by the RenewCo Solar team was precise and informative at all times.RenewCo solar has one new happy customer

After my inverter died and our old system had been in place for 14 years, I started getting quotes from several solar companies. While two companies offered the cheapest phone quotes, I was more interested in a company with a strong reputation and professional service, so I opted for RenewCo Solar.From the moment Matt from RenewCo arrived, I knew I had made the right choice. He was extremely professional, never pushy, and very informative. He took the time to explain all our options and was completely honest in his recommendations. I felt confident in his advice and knew this was the company I wanted to go with.Once we accepted the quote, the communication was excellent. RenewCo kept us informed about everything we needed to do and when to expect the installation.The installation itself was seamless. The team arrived on time, explained the entire process, and installed our new solar system efficiently. They even took the time to clean up thoroughly afterward, which I really appreciated.I would absolutely recommend RenewCo Solar to anyone looking to install or replace a solar system. Their professionalism, communication, and quality of work were exceptional.
Finding an installer that listens and provides options was rare but they did, plus they were polite and respected our needs. Great job.

We reached out to a number of companies for quotes but RenewCo Solar was the only one that turned up to our house...all the others used satellite imagery to provide a quote for panels and a battery. We wanted really good panels and a high capacity battery so got the Powerwall 3 with REC Alpha Pure RX panels. The quoting process was efficient although there were a few things I had to go back to them on with the quote, but these were all sorted very quickly. Install was very good, and the team cleaned up after themselves. At least so far (noting we only installed a week ago) system is working well...more than 80% of the time we don't need to pull any power from the grid.

Punctual appointments, knowledgeable and communicative sales people and solid back up staff and installers. Quote was for 13 panels but during installation there was room for more so they added another 4 at good price. When I get the battery, I will be making money, not paying a bill. The two way tariff process was explained well.

Firstly, they were the only company to physically turn up and view my property. Todd the salesman was great sat and talked me through the whole process what size/type system they would recommend and why. Installation was arranged with minimal delay, the install team turned up on time and completed the installation neatly and professionally.A new smart meter install was arranged and again carried out with no fuss or bother. The system is generating the amount of electricity or better than advised.Follow up has been good with a dedicated Whatsapp chat group, any questions I have asked have been answered quickly with additional information.Not the cheapest system advertised but I wanted a good quality system with a provider who will be there long term to provide any support I may need.

Getting all three quotes was critical to making my decision. After the first quote I was sure I was going to go with them. Then after the second quote, which came in much cheaper, I was sure I was go with them as a value proposition.  Ended up going with RenewCo, who came in at the most expensive, but gave me the most tailored, but more importantly, the optimal solar system for my needs. Installation was neat and I remain happy with the after installation service.

I chose Renewco as they were the only installers that advised me on a bigger system of kWh (which is covering my needs for the near future instead of looking at a lower basis), with better quality solar panels and advised me on the fact I was eligible to a rebate from my council!Their WhatsApp customer service is super handy as I can chat with the whole team as soon as something comes up

Quoting process was straightforward and informative. The best response by far after making our initial inquiries , including a site visit. Subsequent extension of current system was completed in a timely and professional manor. No complaints, would/will recommend, and looking forward to the next stage of battery installation. Thank you.

We are quite happy with our experience.They took the time to visit the site, are hyper accessible for questions and queries and were competitive in pricing.They also had a more rounded understanding - of the electrical and metering needs, and didn’t focus just on the solar panels which would have tripped them up.They really took the time to understand what our objectives were and made a solution accordingly.Would definitely recommend them to others.

Very happy with our experience with Renewco Solar which included quoting in person and then efficient installation process within 3 weeks by a courteous and helpful team.  Now 3 weeks later all going smoothly.In addition to the solar installation they replaced a gas hot water system with an electric heat pump and substituted an electric stove for a gas one in order to deal with an inaccessible gas leak we had inside our house.  All done and dusted in one day.   They also handled the paperwork with our energy retailer for grid connection.  Their ongoing backup via Whatsapp group is efficient and provides peace of mind.

RenewCo Solar have provided great service starting with a really clear explanation of the options, a transparent quote and no pressure to sign up. The system offered great value for money, as we received a superior product for less than what other companies were quoting. Installation went smoothly; they turned up and completed the job in line with the times given and left the site clean.The system is set up, they took care of the rebates and grid connection. After having a terrible experience with another provider, we could not be happier with the service we received from RenewCo Solar.

RenewCo Solar spent the time required to ensure we received the optimal solution for our property, the installation team was professional and courteous and the ongoing customer service has been of the highest standard.  A high quality outcome at a competitive price with peace of mind.
